'''2015 San Diego Grand Prix Results Greg Shaw DS My Kind Of Scum''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]] (Results).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Kind Of Scum]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-san-diego-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130400/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-san-diego-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
